title: Game feel: hit flash, screen shake, helmet wobble
description: Render-only feedback the visual pass left out: hit flash on the victim's fill (back hits stronger), capped decaying screen shake (explosions, hard dive hits, tumble bounces), helmet spring wobble, render-only hit-stop; feel tunables; prefers-reduced-motion respected. No sim change. Game design SSOT: documentation/game/GAME_DESIGN_DOCUMENT.md; product reading: documentation/DOC_APP_VISION.md.

title: Gamepad support and verification
description: The owner has only verified keyboard play. Make up to 4 gamepads work end to end: join, move, aim (stick), jump, fire/dive, hot-plug and disconnect, sensible deadzones; then the owner verifies with real controllers. Game design SSOT: documentation/game/GAME_DESIGN_DOCUMENT.md; product reading: documentation/DOC_APP_VISION.md.

title: Material collision sounds
description: Follow-up from the sound lap: give the terrain materials real impact/destroy sounds (the catalog's thud and crumble are still silent) and use the saved dive-impact spares. Same process as the SFX lap: palette in DESIGN_LANGUAGE.md § 8, small test batch with explicit durations, owner picks on an artifact, then wire through the content catalog (pnpm level-kit:sync). Game design SSOT: documentation/game/GAME_DESIGN_DOCUMENT.md; product reading: documentation/DOC_APP_VISION.md.

title: Music
description: Upbeat ukulele/marimba loops around 128 BPM per DESIGN_LANGUAGE.md § 8 (lobby loop + match loop + short stingers). The audio duck bus is already wired (explosions duck music). Same owner-guided process as the SFX lap; confirm credit cost with the orchestrator before generating long tracks. Add a music volume next to the SFX volume. Game design SSOT: documentation/game/GAME_DESIGN_DOCUMENT.md; product reading: documentation/DOC_APP_VISION.md.

title: Owner checks in Cursor
description: One-time owner verification of the Cursor hooks from #20 and #24: in Cursor Agent chat on a non-main branch, (1) `git push origin HEAD:main --dry-run` must be blocked; (2) `git status` runs as usual; (3) writing a .ts file with a lint error returns the ESLint errors to the agent. Report any step that behaves differently.

title: Weekend: token-spend pass over skills
description: Weekend only (agent-behavior rule § Token budget); the owner starts it. Measure which skills and loop stages spend the most tokens per lap (loop-check: one subagent per rule, plan-compliance subagent, component lens, size-M parallel lenses; loop-plan review fan-out; browser checks; full-suite runs; large generations) using real session usage where available, then propose cuts with meta-audit-harness (context-cost lens extended to runtime spend). Proposals only; protected-file changes need the owner's yes.
